pilot: The market pastry stall and supper

scenario.title: From Hearth to Snack Cake
scenario.premise: Travel with a kitchen caravan from a roadside breakfast through harvest, rain, a crowded market and the station bakery. Make the food that each stop needs, ending at a Twinkie. This fictional collection brings historical techniques together; time, proportions and safe handling are compressed, not taught.

stage.title: The pastry workshop
stage.speaker: The pastry cook
stage.motivation: Tomorrow is market day, and the stall serves both lunch and dessert. Enclose the bean supper in a pie, use the fruit in a tart, and give the baker a light layered pastry to fill.
